entries.notes: L「may y may」当为 más y más 之省写，H「却添」（khioh-thiam，拾而益之）与之相应。

entries.zh: 收留供养（被弃养者）；收容照料
entries.en: to take in, keep and feed (a foundling or dependent)
entries.notes: L 作 perfido 疑为 perdido 之讹；H「却带飼」当读 khioh-tòa-chhī（拾养），M 栏「hoa」与「带」不尽合。

entries.zh: 收拾、整理归置；调停议定
entries.en: to gather up and set in order; to arrange or settle
entries.notes: L「con proof」疑为 con provecho 之缩写，义仍归「收拾」。

entries.en: to gather up or arrange; to put in order
entries.notes: H「收除」非通行词，唯 M「tũ」与「除 tû」对音，义从 L「componer」取收拢整理。

entries.zh: 拾取穷人所弃剩之物（备自用）
entries.en: to pick up what is left over by the poor (for one's own use)
entries.notes: L 短语讹误（probes 应作 pobres，「lo fiera」不可解），释义据 H「却处使」（khioh-tè-sái）推之。

entries.zh: 和好、当面修好（恢复情谊）
entries.en: to reconcile; to make up (a friendship)
to be reconciled; to settle or conclude (a matter)
entries.notes: H、M 两栏原件空缺，R「Hoc jīm」所指汉字未定，L 后半「le concluir」文义亦不明。

entries.zh: 认服、甘拜下风（承认对方占优）
entries.en: to acknowledge another's superiority; to concede defeat
entries.notes: H 栏原字残泐（封存记作 [疑:默/煞]），据 M「qieng」及次条「敬服」推为「敬」。

entries.en: to yield in respect; to acknowledge superiority with deference
to feel ashamed and grateful (for a benefit received)
entries.notes: R 栏多出「cay tory」「siān ley」等音节，疑并入邻条或旁注，H、M、R 三者不能完全对齐。

entries.en: to admit oneself beaten; to yield
entries.notes: H「犯伊跤」字面与「认输」不合，M「poa」亦不与「跤 kha」对音，释义仅据 L。

entries.en: to acknowledge a kindness; to bear a favour in mind
to accept a kindness with gratitude; acknowledgement of a favour
to recline propped up (on the hand)
entries.notes: H 仅一字「托」而 R 作两音节「tog te」，且标圈注，具体姿势存疑。

entries.en: to lie face down with the head resting on the ground
to lean on; to rely upon another

entries.notes: H「光景」本指景物境况，此处取游赏怡情之义；R 后半「para iso irg」疑为旁注残文。
